selected_reference.scope: Source-declared isolated two-site model with one a and one f particle, not the entire experimental law.
selected_reference.hamiltonian: H(tau)=-J(a2^dag a1+f2^dag f1+h.c.)+U sum_j n_j^a n_j^f+Delta_f n1^f+A cos(omega tau+phi)(n1^a+n1^f)
selected_reference.field: tau_z=n2^f-n1^f; tau_x=f1^dag f2+h.c.; dynamical operators, not prerecorded scalar flux.
selected_reference.readout: Q1=exp(i*pi*n1^a), tau_z; site/state-resolved density averages over an array.
selected_reference.time: Laboratory seconds; energy-valued J,U,Delta_f,A; angular frequency omega; i*hbar*d_tau V(tau,s)=H(tau)V(tau,s). Driven two-parameter propagation is not an autonomous group or time emergence.
selected_reference.limits: Fixed double well. No thermodynamic, continuum, lattice-removal or cosmological limit.
source_boundaries: S.1 additionally assumes Delta_f=U; Eq.3 keeps Delta_f independent. The experiment does not make them exactly equal.
Eq.4 is lowest-order Floquet dynamics. The source states it is Z2 symmetric for general chi; J0(chi0)=J2(chi0) removes density dependence, not all symmetry.
